description: This file defines the 'Links' class in the SuiteCRM JSON API v1 namespace, implementing response link handling with pagination, URL validation, and logging.

classes.name: Links
classes.description: A class representing JSON API links with support for pagination, URL validation, and logging.

methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the Links class.
